verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs describe it as optimized for instant, sub-50ms search-as-you-type, and community users praise its instant queries. That covers prefix autocomplete over indexed documents. Nothing in the pack shows query suggestions built from real search traffic or a dedicated suggestions index. Missing for 10: query-suggestion generation from search analytics/popular queries, a documented suggestions index or collection workflow, and hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.
